card.name: Linking words inside skin and dose phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words or word starts (increased, sub, with, of, to) in the middle of drug-label sentences, often about skin application, absorption, injections, or dose.

modes.description: Short words like with, of, to, or inward that sit between a noun and the next medical term.
